start: Payment details never set; signed in within the last 15 minutes

steps.action: Open 'Payments' and look at 'Your payment details'
user_sees: 'Not set: gym owners see “Payment is not available yet” and no QR code. Fill these in to start taking payments.'
must_not: The fold closed when nothing is set

steps.action: Fill 'UPI ID', 'Name on UPI', 'Account name', 'Account number', 'IFSC', tap 'Save payment details'
user_sees: Question 'Change where gym owners send money?'
'Saved. Gym owners see the new details the next time they open Pay MettleUp.'
must_not: A wrong UPI ID saved without a check
An owner's Pay MettleUp showing the old details after reopening

user_sees: The fold closed, 'What gym owners pay to: UPI <id>'
must_not: The account number shown in the folded line

steps.action: Open the fold, change the UPI ID, save and confirm
user_sees: 'Gym owners see these on Pay MettleUp (a UPI QR code with the amount, and the bank details). Last changed <time>.'
must_not: The other fields emptied by the change

start: Payments page, sign-in older than 15 minutes

steps.action: Change a field, tap 'Save payment details', OK
user_sees: 'For this, sign in again first (it must be within the last 15 minutes).' and 'Sign in again'
must_not: The details changed on an old sign-in

steps.action: Tap 'Save payment details', then Cancel in the question
Open Payments before the database update 0060
user_sees: 'Payments need the database update 0060 (waiting for your yes).' in the card

start: Details not set, then set, then changed

steps.action: Save details for the first time, reload Payments
user_sees: The fold now closed with 'What gym owners pay to: UPI <id>'
must_not: 'Not set yet' still shown after a good save

steps.action: Change only the bank name and save
must_not: The UPI ID changed by the bank-name save

user_sees: 'Kept only in the gym server, never in the code. Any signed-in gym owner can read them, so a UPI ID without your mobile number is safer.'
must_not: The details readable by anyone not signed in
